priorityList: Ensure every non-Kill Command cast is affected by a stack
Cast Kill Command to generate stacks if you run out
Cast Kill Command if it has a proc (it glows)
Cast Wildfire Bomb only to extend buff
Cast Takedown regardless of conditions if you would otherwise have nothing to do
Use as many as possible Kill Command in any given fight.
Do not use Kill Command too aggressively to avoid wasting generated Focus.
Use Kill Command as much as possible in any given encounter without over-capping on Focus.
Use two abilities between each use of Kill Command.
Maximize the uses of Raptor Strike.
